catches: Referring customers receive an account credit of $50 for each referral that meets the checking offer requirements; promo code REFERRAL50-2026 at account opening.
Offer valid for qualifying accounts opened 9/1/2026 through 12/31/2026; available in Oklahoma only.
Friend (new customer) must open an eligible consumer checking account and have direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days of account opening.
$50 referral credit paid into the referrer's MidFirst checking account within 30 days after requirements are met; maximum one account credit per new customer.
Referrer cannot live in the same household as the referred customer; limited to one per household.
Not available to existing MidFirst Bank consumer checking customers or those with accounts closed during the current or previous calendar year.
Credits reported on IRS Form 1099-INT as interest; accounts closed within 90 days of opening may forfeit the credit.
